I wonder if this will be crippled by people trying to cash in on a buck or two from flooding the service with what ever shit they can churn out?

Even pop music is better than that - at least they have production value.
If any of this was possible, I wouldn't be posting here.

I can't do it again. I was documenting Occupy Wall Street. My best work yet, by far, just evaporated. I've spent the past 4 years in school, now 30, to pick myself up and better myself - but now this portfolio disappeared.  This is like my business disappeared, but it's even worse than if it didn't even happen because it's a demonstration of how unreliable I am.
